coverage_summary: Reviewed the supplied 42-second clip and five telemetry observations; most gameplay details are not instrumented.
coverage_limitations: Only selected properties and one signal were available.

findings.title: Health display may remain stale after damage
findings.observed_behavior: A damage signal is recorded, internal health drops from 5 to 4, but the sampled HUD value remains 5 at 12.8 seconds.
findings.expected_behavior: The HUD should reflect the current authoritative health after damage.
findings.explanation: The watched state and HUD value disagree after the damage event. Visual confirmation is needed to determine whether the displayed bar is also stale.
benign_alternatives: The UI may intentionally animate or delay updates; no acceptable delay was declared.
reproduction_steps: In a similar gameplay state, take a single hit and compare the health bar with the internal health value.
limitations: The fixture does not prove what the actual rendered HUD looked like.
The expected maximum UI update latency is unspecified.
